Nora Patel: Hey team, quick capture from NeonPilot onboarding + first-week usage. Want raw notes to feed product triage. Please drop one-line pain/ask + repro + suggested priority.
Samir Khan: 1) Data residency confusion: customer in EU couldn't find where to enable EU-only storage for logs. Thought it was automatic. Impact: delayed go-live for their compliance team. Repro: Settings -> Data -> region dropdown not visible if account created before region rollout. Priority: high. Suggestion: show banner + migration button in project settings.
Olivia Wright: 2) Embedding namespace mapping: they expected our import to preserve custom namespace tags, but bulk CSV import flattened namespaces. Impact: broke downstream search relevance. Repro: import csv with namespace column -> all vectors imported to default namespace. Priority: medium. Suggestion: add explicit namespace column mapping in import UI and example CSV.
Julian Park: 3) Live latency spikes during long demos: when a client demoed a 20-turn chat, latency jumped after 12th turn due to KV cache growth. Impact: bad demo, reduced confidence. Priority: high. Suggestion: telemetry docs + recommended demo model/sequence length or an option to cap KV memory for demo sessions.
Nora Patel: 4) Renewal blocker ask: their legal wants explicit cert for our dedicated customer's KMS integration (HSM-backed). They won't renew without it. Priority: high. Suggestion: escalate to security/compliance for a cert or a short-term attestation.
Samir Khan: 5) Route-level feature request: ability to tag routes with billing codes so finance can auto-map charges to cost centers. Impact: tedious manual reconciliation. Priority: medium. Suggestion: add a small 'billing code' field on route config and include in export.
Olivia Wright: 6) Docs/SDK mismatch: quickstart shows `client.generate` example but their SDK version only has `client.create_completion`. New users hit runtime errors. Priority: high for first-session UX. Suggestion: add versioned snippets and a compatibility note at top.
Julian Park: 7) Observability gap: support asked for a sample query to find requests that used fallback model variants (we do fallbacks automatically). Impact: harder to debug quality regressions. Priority: medium. Suggestion: add 'fallback_reason' in request logs and a saved query in console.
Nora Patel: Ops-bot, create a one-question micro-pulse for NeonPilot asking biggest blocker and ask permission to follow up?
ops-bot: Micro-pulse link created: https://rwd.surveys/NP-MICRO-1 (expires in 10 days) :white_check_mark:
Samir Khan: I'll attach the demo recording + logs to the ticket.
Olivia Wright: I'll draft the import CSV example and paste it here.
Nora Patel: I'm marking high-priority items for CS escalation: data residency + demo latency + SDK mismatch + legal/KMS cert. Will open tickets and ping product/security.
Julian Park: Noted. I'll work with infra to add a short demo-mode doc and a KV cap flag proposal.
Nora Patel: Thanks everyone. I'll synthesize this into the customer feedback doc and add contact details for follow-up. Please keep replies short so I can copy-paste into the ticket. :thumbsup:
